The graph carries 18 identical 'VA Medical Centers' nodes, one under each curated VISN, each with the same 26 template position children -- a placeholder for the set of medical centres in a network, not a unit the government names. Probed VA's own pages rather than assuming it: https://department.va.gov/integrated-service-networks/ reads 1,722 characters and labels its networks 'VISN 1' through 'VISN 5' with no unit called 'VA Medical Centers'; https://department.va.gov/veterans-health-administration/ and https://www.va.gov/health/ (9,441 readable characters each) and https://www.va.gov/health-care/ (4,065) label VHA's staff offices and programmes and likewise carry no such unit. https://www.visn7.va.gov/ could not be reached at all -- its robots.txt raised URLError, so the probe refused it by policy -- and https://www.va.gov/southeast-network-health-care/ is HTTP 404. Two curation findings for the parent chain, not fixable by any URL here: that same VA page states 'The Department of Veterans Affairs comprises 5 Veterans Integrated Service Networks or VISNs', against the graph's 18, and its VISN 2 covers 'Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, U.S. Virgin Islands, and Virginia' -- the Southeast -- so the parent 'VISN 7 - Southeast' no longer exists under that number on VA's own page. Separately, the verifier already refuses the parent's name as a curated_count_label, so even a correct page could not confirm it.

The parent committee's own subcommittees page reads fine and labels exactly six subcommittees: 'General Farm Commodities, Risk Management, and Credit', 'Forestry and Horticulture', 'Conservation, Research, and Biotechnology', 'Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture', 'Subcommittee on Livestock, Dairy, and Poultry' and 'Commodity Markets, Digital Assets, and Rural Development'. The curated name 'Subcommittee on Horticulture, Farm Inputs & Subcommittee on Precision Agriculture' is none of them, and it reads like two names merged, since it carries 'Subcommittee on' twice. Horticulture sits under the page's own wording 'Forestry and Horticulture'. The committed House Clerk list agrees independently: under AG00 it carries 'Forestry and Horticulture' (AG15) and 'Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture' (AG03) and no subcommittee whose name contains 'Farm Inputs' or 'Precision Agriculture'. This is a rename argued from the page's own wording, not a missing URL: on the same fetch four sibling curated subcommittees did match this page, three of them through the committee fold.
